# AIST++ Validation - DLT Baseline

*Report generated by `experiments/run_aistpp_dlt_baseline.py`*

## Overall Results

| Metric | Value |
|---|---|
| Clips | 128 |
| Total frames | 105269 |
| MPJPE (mm) | 22.92 |
| PA-MPJPE (mm) | 29.35 |
| Reprojection error (px) | 18.05 |

### Notes

- MPJPE/PA-MPJPE are reported in millimetres.
- AIST++ canonical files are scaled to metres (`scale_factor=0.01`).
- DLT is confidence-weighted per joint and per view.
- NaN 2D observations are zero-weighted and ignored by the triangulation.
- Aggregates are weighted by clip length in frames.

## Outlier Analysis

A minority of clips have large DLT errors, usually accompanied by high reprojection error, which suggests corrupted or missing 2D detections rather than a calibration problem.
